    emitter.instruction("and x9, x9, #0xffffffffffff80ff");                     // clear the value_type lane
    emitter.instruction("orr x9, x9, #0x900");                                  // runtime tag 9 = resource
    emitter.instruction("str x9, [x0, #-8]");                                   // publish it for the renderers'''
new='''    emitter.instruction("ldr x9, [x0, #-8]");                                   // the container kind word

    // immediate, which the assembler rejects rather than truncating.
    emitter.instruction("mov x10, #0x7f00");                                    // the value_type lane
    emitter.instruction("bic x9, x9, x10");                                     // clear it
    emitter.instruction("mov x10, #0x900");                                     // runtime tag 9 = resource
    emitter.instruction("orr x9, x9, x10");                                     // set it
    emitter.instruction("str x9, [x0, #-8]");                                   // publish it for the renderers'''
assert s.count(old)==1
open(p,'w').write(s.replace(old,new))
print("masks materialised")
